name: Memukan
title: Advisor to King Ahasuerus
summary: Memukan was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to the king's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom. He is best known for his advice to King Ahasuerus to depose Queen Vashti after she refused to obey the king's command. His counsel led to a royal decree that paved the way for Esther to later become queen.

keyEvents.title: One of the King's Seven Advisors
keyEvents.description: Memukan is mentioned as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who sat closest to the king and held the foremost positions in the kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Queen Vashti's Disobedience
keyEvents.description: When Queen Vashti refused to come when King Ahasuerus sent for her during a great feast, the king became furious and asked his advisors what should be done.

keyEvents.title: Memukan's Advice to the King
keyEvents.description: Memukan spoke up among the advisors and claimed that Vashti's disobedience was not only an offense against the king but against all the princes and peoples in the provinces of the kingdom, and that other women would follow her example.

keyEvents.title: The Proposal to Depose Vashti
keyEvents.description: Memukan proposed that a royal decree be issued stating that Vashti should never again appear before King Ahasuerus, and that her royal dignity be given to another who was better than she.

keyEvents.title: The Royal Decree
keyEvents.description: The king and the princes followed Memukan's advice, and letters were sent to all the provinces of the kingdom stating that every man should be master in his own house. This decree paved the way for Esther's elevation to queen.
